seo.description: Enjoy a trip in the valleys of Meghalaya and plains of Assam by booking our Assam-Meghalaya tour packages at the best price with Kajaawa.

items: Hotel
Transportation
Breakfast

content.text: Northeast India, with its rolling hills and valleys, waterfalls, culture, traditions, and life celebrations, is an adventure hunt for explorers. This tour wrap offers you the first-rate display of Meghalaya with the engaging scapes of Umiam Lake, the lovely Seven Sisters Falls, Nohkalikai Falls, Waba Kaba Falls, sublime caves and the Police Bazar, Don Bosco Museum, Dawkee Bridge and River Boating, Balancing Rock, Air force Museum, Kaziranga Wildlife Sanctuary,Orchid Park,Jungle Safaris,Guwahati sightseeing.

main.title: Tour Highlights
items: Visit Umiam Lake (Barapani), the world's largest mannered lake
For evening fragment, wander in the famed Police Bazar and Don Bosco Museum
Dawki Bridge, River Boating, Balancing Rock are all worth seeing
Take a deviation to Cherrapunjee, the world's wettest city
Nohsngithiang and Waba Kaba Falls are spectacular to see along with the Air Force Museum
Safari to Kaziranga Wildlife Sanctuary and Orchid Park
Enjoy Safari in the famous Kaziranga National Park
At Guwahati, take a thrilling tour to Sankardev Kalakshetra Science Museum, a lovely sunset cruise and markets

main.title: 7 Days Fascinating Assam Meghalaya Tour Itinerary

days.title: Day 1 : Arrival at Guwahati- Short Shillong Tour
items: Arriving at Guwahati Airport or Railway Station, you will be greeted before being driven to Shillong.
On the way, you can catch the site of the enchantingly mannered Barapani aka Umiam Lake, Don Bosco Museum showcasing the best artifacts, cultural clothing and native tools of Shillong.
Also witness the breathtaking Lake of Ward's and Lady Hydari Park which is a water present and partial zoo.
Evenings can be utilized to explore the surroundings so shopping at the Police Bazar would be fun and worthwhile.
Later check in at your accommodation in Shillong.

days.title: Day 2 : Outing to Mawlynnong and Dawki
items: Get through with breakfast and be ready by 8AM for the mesmerizing one day tour to Mawlynnong and Dawki.
You will be witnessing the Living Root Bridge formed by tangling the roots of plants, nature's wonder- the Balancing Rock.
Next stop would be the visit to the greenest place chosen as Asia's cleanest village by 'Discover India Magazine' - Mawlynnong Village.
Another spot would be Dawki, catching sight of the ultimate Dawkee Bridge and the River Boating in the enthralling see through glass like Umngot River aka Dawki River.
Visit to the Bangladesh Border would be the last spot for the day.
Check in at your homestay or hotel in Dawki.

days.title: Day 3 : Expedition to Cherrapunjee
items: After breakfast, get all set to take a day trip to Cherrapunjee, the world's wettest place.
Stop to capture the sight of a group of vintage aircrafts in the Air Force Museum along with the peaceful Ramakrishna Mission Ashrama.
Next visit would be to the spectacular Falls of Cherrapunjee namely the Nohsngithiang Falls(Seven Sisters Falls), Wah Kaba Falls and Nohkalikai Falls.
Then, take a relaxing walk within the limestone cave- Mawsmai Cave and the Eco Park.
Return back to the hotel at Cherrapunjee, where you will spend the night.

days.title: Day 4 : Cherrapunjee to Kaziranga Tour
items: Check out from the hotel after breakfast and leave for Kaziranga through Kolia Bhomora Setu.
On the way, you can enjoy the Brahmaputra Cruise and the Dolphin sight seeing on the bridge.
Then stop straight at the Kaziranga Wildlife Sanctuary, exploring the nature's gateways.
Evenings could be kept for enjoying the cultural programs amd variety of flower species at the Orchid Park and detouring the local markets.
Rest and spend the night in the hotel.

days.title: Day 5 : Kaziranga Tent Camps and Jungle Safaris
items: Check out of the hotel following breakfast.
Reach to the sight of Tent and after lunch, you can enjoy the jeep safari and witness beautiful bird species and rhino sightings.
Enjoy the overnight stay at the Tent place.
NOTE: The Elephant Safari depends on the availability, in that case you would be taken to the Safari via jeep.

days.title: Day 6 : Kaziranga to Guwahati
items: Leave the Tent Site after morning breakfast and drive straight to Guwahati.
You are expected to reach by afternoon and can check in to the hotel.
After lunch and apt rest, you can start with a trip to the city.
Start with Sankardev Kalakshetra Science Museum that symbolizes diversified ethnic diversity of Assam.
Located opposite Assam museum is the War Memorial which is a bijou park in Uzan Bazaar. This is staunched for the courageous martyrs who lost their lives for the nation.
Local markets visit would suffice for the evening along with the sunset or dinner cruise at Alfresco Grand only as per your wish.
Check in at your hotel in Guwahati.

days.title: Day 7 : Departure
items: Check out of the hotel following the breakfast.
A drive to Guwahati Airport or Railway Station will end the tour.

items.text: Travellers visiting Meghalaya are required to register on Meghalaya Tourism App and generate an e-invite.
You can download the Meghalaya Tourism App from Google Play Store or App Store.
No reimbursement will be made against missed services.
Travellers are required to show their valid identity cards at the time of check-in to the hotel.
You should not consume alcohol or other intoxicants during your tour.
The vehicle allotted for the tour will be available as per the itinerary and not for general disposal.
In the Northeast, generally, vehicles like Sedan do not have carriers. You are advised to carry one bag per person. Kindly give us prior information in case you have more luggage.

Delay in arrival due to many reasons including flight reschedules shall have to inform to us at an earliest and in case of any sightseeing spot missed due to any delay including spending more time in one sightseeing spot, will not be refundable.

Kajaawa will provide accommodation as per the hotels in the list and in case the listed hotels cannot be provided for any reason like unavailability, scheduled or general maintenance, accident at the hotel, risky road conditions due to bad weather or political disturbance, similar hotels will be provided and you will be informed about the changes in advance.

In Deluxe and Premium Tour Packages, we will generally arrange Deluxe and Premium Hotels but in interior places, we will arrange Homestays, Guest Houses or Standard Hotels as Deluxe and Premium accommodations may not be available in the interiors for any reason.
In case of any unforeseen situations which are beyond our control including bad weather conditions, political disturbance etc., we may change your itinerary or dates of travel.
Travellers may have to bear additional expenses in case of natural calamity including situations like changes in the hotel, changes in tour date etc.
You have to pay 50% of the total tour cost at the time of booking.
After paying 50% you will receive an invoice of your payment and also booking confirmation details containing your detailed travel itinerary and hotel information.
25% of the total cost, if the tour is cancelled 30 days before the tour starts.
50% of the total cost, if the tour is cancelled 15-30 days before the tour starts.
100% of the total cost, if the tour is cancelled 0-15 days before the tour starts.
100% of the tour cost has to be paid 1 (one) week before the tour starts.
Refunds will be processed within 7(seven) business days in the customer’s bank account.
